entries.english:
19 March 1509 (Monday after Laetare); Wilhelm von Vellberg, Amtmann zu Werdeck, Simon von Stetten zu Ingelfingen, and Wilhelm von Bemburg zu Michelfeld stand surety to Zaisolph von Rosenberg zu Niederstetten, in place of three citizens who had been approached, for a loan of 1,000 florins made to the brothers Christoph and Jörg von Wollmershausen, with annual interest of 50 florins; seal: the issuers, 1st–3rd. Parchment, 3 seals (1st and 2nd missing, 3rd damaged).

Date range: 1509

Extent: original copy; parchment, 3 seals
